title: Busy day at the mall
content: Last night I had a dream that I was in a mall world. Somehow I knew I was dreaming so I did a reality check by plugging my nose and it worked. I realized I was in the food court with tall ceilings and huge windows above. I started flying up to them but I got scared flying up that high. I began walking around the mall to try to find a quiet place to meditate instead. However, whenever I leave the food court to find a room for meditation, I never seem to find one. The mall was very busy and it was hard to keep focus. I’ve been in this mall before and I think it’s funny that my one problem is that I can never find a quiet place there to meditate. The best part is just flying around and trying to dodge all of the people walking around 😂
